# Copywriting

Write or refine clear, persuasive website and product copy.

[All skills](index.md) · [Collection overview](../../README.md) · [Research and inspiration](../../standards/framework-evidence.md)

## When to use it

When the user wants to write or rewrite page copy (homepage, landing, pricing, feature), or asks which headline, promise, or message to lead with. Diagnoses the input first (blank brief, real voice, or point edit) and changes only what it calls for. Claims must be supportable; a declined claim names the evidence that would unlock it. No AI tells like 'it's not X, it's Y' or 'no X, no Y, no Z'. For editing, see copy-editing. For emails, see emails. For the offer, see offers.

Example request:

> Use copywriting to improve this work using its complete upstream guidance.

Expected result: An output shaped by the complete upstream instructions, source material and the task at hand.

## Install and use

Install this skill from the versioned collection in a supported Agent Skills environment:

```sh
npx skills add https://github.com/theGeekist/skills/tree/v1.10.0 --skill copywriting
```

Select the intended agent and installation scope when prompted. This CLI installation is separate from ChatGPT plugin registration and mobile availability. Client discovery and activation require their own verification.

Read the [complete skill instructions](../../skills/copywriting/SKILL.md) and [bundled purpose reference](../../skills/copywriting/references/GEEKIST-UPSTREAM.md) for the full conditions and exceptions.
